- **Auto reup** – while you are recruiting, the listing is renewed on a
  configurable interval (default **55 minutes**, just before the 60‑minute
  expiry, so there is no gap where your party drops off the board).
- **Opt-in** – nothing happens until you enable it.
- **Leader-safe** – by default it only acts when you are the party leader (or
  recruiting solo), so it never touches someone else's recruitment.
- **Comment preservation** – re-applies your listing description if the game
  clears it during a renewal.

| Command | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| `/pfreup` | Open the settings window |
| `/pfreup on` | Enable auto reup |
| `/pfreup off` | Disable auto reup |
| `/pfreup now` | Reup your listing right now |
| `/pfreup status` | Print current status to chat |

1. In game, open Dalamud settings: `/xlsettings` → **Experimental**.
2. Under **Custom Plugin Repositories**, paste this URL into the empty box and
   click the **+**, then **Save**:
   ```
   https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GaugeMage/PartyFinderReup/main/pluginmaster.json
   ```
3. Open `/xlplugins`, search for **Party Finder Reup**, and click **Install**.
4. Type `/pfreup` to open settings and enable auto reup.

## Publishing a new version (for the author)

Releases are automated by GitHub Actions (`.github/workflows/release.yml`).
To cut a release:

1. Bump `<Version>` / `<AssemblyVersion>` in `PartyFinderReup.csproj` and the
   `AssemblyVersion` in both `PartyFinderReup.json` and `pluginmaster.json`.
2. Commit and push.
3. Tag the release and push the tag:
   ```bash
   git tag v1.0.0.0
   git push origin v1.0.0.0
   ```
4. The workflow builds the plugin and attaches `latest.zip` to a GitHub Release.
   Because `pluginmaster.json` points at the *latest release* permalink, users
   get the update automatically — no need to edit `pluginmaster.json` again.

## Building

Requirements:

- The **.NET 10 SDK** (the current Dalamud API 15 targets .NET 10).
- A working XIVLauncher/Dalamud install (the build references the Dalamud
  libraries in `%APPDATA%\XIVLauncher\addon\Hooks\dev`).

```bash
dotnet build -c Release
```

The packaged plugin is produced at:

```
bin/Release/PartyFinderReup/latest.zip
bin/Release/PartyFinderReup/PartyFinderReup.json
```

## Installing (dev plugin)

1. Build the project (see above).
2. In game, open Dalamud settings: `/xlsettings` → **Experimental**.
3. Under **Dev Plugin Locations**, add the full path to the built manifest:
   `...\PartyFinderReup\bin\Release\PartyFinderReup\PartyFinderReup.json`
   (or add the folder that contains it).
4. Open the plugin installer: `/xlplugins` → **Dev Tools** / installed plugins,
   and enable **Party Finder Reup**.
5. Type `/pfreup` to open settings and turn on auto reup.

configured interval it takes the listing down and immediately re-posts it using

# Party Finder Reup

A [Dalamud](https://github.com/goatcorp/Dalamud) plugin for **Final Fantasy XIV** that

timer expires, so your recruitment stays on the board without you having to
manually re-list it every hour.

It re-uses your **last recruitment settings** (duty, description, job
requirements, etc.), so a renewal is identical to the listing you set up.

## Features

- **Auto reup** – while you are recruiting, the listing is renewed on a
  configurable interval (default **55 minutes**, just before the 60‑minute
  expiry, so there is no gap where your party drops off the board).

- **Leader-safe** – by default it only acts when you are the party leader (or
  recruiting solo), so it never touches someone else's recruitment.

- **Manual reup** – `/pfreup now` renews immediately (handy for testing).
- Works quietly in the background – no windows pop up during a renewal.

| Command | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| `/pfreup` | Open the settings window |
| `/pfreup on` | Enable auto reup |
| `/pfreup off` | Disable auto reup |
| `/pfreup now` | Reup your listing right now |
| `/pfreup status` | Print current status to chat |

## Installing (for users)

1. In game, open Dalamud settings: `/xlsettings` → **Experimental**.
2. Under **Custom Plugin Repositories**, paste this URL into the empty box and
   click the **+**, then **Save**:
   ```
   https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GaugeMage/PartyFinderReup/main/pluginmaster.json
   ```

3. Open `/xlplugins`, search for **Party Finder Reup**, and click **Install**.
4. Type `/pfreup` to open settings and enable auto reup.

1. Bump `<Version>` / `<AssemblyVersion>` in `PartyFinderReup.csproj` and the

```
bin/Release/PartyFinderReup/latest.zip
bin/Release/PartyFinderReup/PartyFinderReup.json
```

1. Build the project (see above).
2. In game, open Dalamud settings: `/xlsettings` → **Experimental**.

When you click **Recruit Members**, the plugin records the time. On the

This plugin only automates an action you can already perform manually (re-listing
